claims: As of March 15, 2026, Kimi Antonelli is 19 years old.
Kimi Antonelli was born on August 25, 2006.
Kimi Antonelli is a Mercedes driver.
Kimi Antonelli became the youngest pole-sitter at the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli became the second-youngest Formula 1 Grand Prix winner at the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix
